description: 𝐍𝐀𝐒𝐈𝐉 is a wool traceability and operations monorepo built with Flutter, FastAPI, React/Vite, and Supabase. It spans an offline-first mobile app, dual FastAPI backends, a MUI/Leaflet dashboard, and detachable AI/ML microservices for a hackathon-scale supply-chain platform.
Real-time road accident severity prediction — Kafka → Spark Structured Streaming → MongoDB → Live Leaflet dashboard | 84% RF accuracy | 12K predictions | 213 spike alerts
Next.js + Leaflet dashboard visualizing GFS/WRF weather data (temp, wind, cloud cover) and farm boundaries, with satellite, streets & NASA GIBS historical base layers.

Conceptual flood vulnerability map of Tahirpur Sadar Union, Sunamganj haor region, Bangladesh — 283 HaRPI-surveyed features scored & classified, published as a QField project + Leaflet dashboard. In collaboration with Open Mapping Hub Asia Pacific.

An end-to-end IoT monitoring system that detects road potholes & waste in real time using a custom-trained YOLOv8 model, ESP32-CAM, Arduino (ultrasonic depth measurement), and a live React/Leaflet dashboard powered by Flask and WebSockets.
Leaflet dashboard with markers showing locations
